$Comment: The zone 1 plains, split out of Talus_Zone1 so the Roaming Temple can spawn here and nowhere else. An environment is owned by exactly one rule and a second rule naming it is ignored, so the plains needs a rule of its own. The two talus variants retain equal weight.
The temple is two of the thirty-two weight, or about one plains cell in forty-six once Chance is applied. Terrain checks can reject additional sites.
